title: Related Columns

illustrates.quote: Related columns show a relationship between entries across a row of columns but no relationship between entries in one row with entries in another row.

print.surroundingText: 11.2.5 General Format (rules a–g) follows the example.
print.printFeatures: Bordered box with ruled line under the header row and ruled lines between every data row. Header row is bold.

braille.notes: Column headings are left-adjusted (not capitalized as full words after the first, e.g. 'Infinitive'->',9f9itive' uses the capital indicator only once). Row entries use literary-braille contractions freely (e.g. 'become'->'2come' using the 'be' contraction '2', 'bear'->'be>' with the 'ar' sign, 'bore'->'bore' plain). The 'be' row's Past column 'was, were' is rendered 'was1 7 be5' where '1' is the comma and '7' is the word 'were' contracted; guide dots (") lead from the shorter word to the separation-line width in every column.

uncertain: The exact UEB contraction meanings of tokens like '2', '1', '7', 'b1t' are copied character-for-character from the source text as instructed, without independently re-deriving the braille translation dot-by-dot.
